Caveat: in these solutions the spin axis (vertical) is far from the axis of maximum inertia (dashed), so they are not stable, relaxed rotators. The soft b/c prior used in this run was too weak; a rerun with an inertia-based constraint is needed before the pole solution is final.

Body frame: z (vertical) is the spin axis. Volume normalised to 1. Each shape is shown rotated about its spin axis so the longest equatorial axis lies along x; the rotational phase is a gauge freedom of the inversion. Physical orientations (phase 0 at tref) are in the OBJ files.
